verdict: StudyFlow wins a small niche (about 8% of the simulated market) but is fragile: it depends on exam-focused students accepting S$7 against a free alternative.
who_buys: Exam-focused students who value AI planning
who_rejects: Budget-conscious students whose budget is below S$7

risks.title: Free alternative absorbs most demand
risks.evidence: 61% of simulated customers stay with the free planner

risks.title: Price sensitivity higher than assumed
risks.evidence: Share more than halves if price sensitivity rises 20%

risks.title: Integrations gap versus ChainApp
risks.evidence: Power users pick ChainApp for integrations

experiments.title: Two-price landing page
experiments.hypothesis: At least 8% of 100 visitors join the waitlist at S$7/month

experiments.title: Exam-student interviews
experiments.hypothesis: Exam-focused students would pay S$7 for AI planning over a free tool
experiments.pass_threshold: 4 of 5 interviewees name a concrete trigger to switch

experiments.title: Price ladder survey
experiments.hypothesis: Median willingness to pay among exam students is at least S$6

trend_context.trend: Rising cost of living is squeezing student budgets
